room_description: A brightly lit room featuring blue wallpaper with yellow stars, a teal sofa, an abstract painting, a modern white desk setup with a laptop, and a patterned rug on the floor.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the star-wallpapered room.
Lifting the pillow on the teal sofa.
Finding a silver key hidden behind the sofa pillow.
Unlocking the drawer to find a compact disc (CD).
Inspecting the laptop which asks for a numeric password.
Examining the abstract wall art to find hidden numbers.
Entering the code '739' into the laptop.
Viewing the red dot pattern on the laptop screen.
Inputting the pattern into the metal pegboard on the wall to reveal the final key.

solution_steps: Tap on the teal sofa to zoom in.
Lift the left decorative pillow to reveal the item.
Use the silver key on the lock of the top drawer to open it.
Look closely at the abstract painting hanging on the wall.
Identify the faint numbers embedded in the corners and design.
Use the on-screen keypad to enter the code '739'.
Observe the 5x4 grid pattern with specific red dots.
Locate the metal panel with circular holes.
Tap the corresponding holes to turn them red, matching the pattern exactly as seen on the laptop screen.

final_action: The player takes the key revealed from the hidden compartment behind the metal pegboard and uses it to unlock the main brown door and exit the room.
